# Migrating from SDK API v1 to v2

<!-- Generated by renderMigrationGuide() in src/migration.ts; edit that file, not this one. -->

SDK API v1 is integration code written against the legacy contract surface (storage schema 0, count-based approvals, no roles, direct recurring-schedule entrypoints). v2 is this package. Run `checkCompatibility(await readContractSurface(client))` to see which contract migrations a deployment still needs, and `runCodemods(source)` to rewrite the mechanical changes below and list the rest for review.

## Compatibility matrix

| SDK API | Status | Contract | Storage schema | Event schema | Weighted governance | RBAC | @stellar/stellar-sdk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| v1 | deprecated | 1–1 | 0–0 | 0–1 | no | no | — |
| v2 | current | 1–1 | 1–1 | 2–2 | yes | yes | ^13.0.0 \|\| ^14.0.0 \|\| ^15.0.0 |

## Breaking changes

### `ProposalExecutedEvent` no longer carries `transfers`

Event schema 2 dropped the transfer list from the executed event to keep large batches under the 16 KiB event limit. Read transfers from `ProposalCreatedEvent` or `getProposal(id).kind`. Codemod: `flag-executed-event-transfers`.

```ts
// v1
sub.on("proposal_executed", (e) => pay(e.data.transfers));
// v2
sub.on("proposal_executed", async (e) => {
  const { kind } = await client.getProposal(BigInt(e.data.id as string));
  if ("Transfer" in kind) pay(kind.Transfer);
});
```

### Quorum is measured in weight, snapshotted per proposal

Approvals are weighted and each proposal snapshots `quorum_weight` at creation. Compare `approval_weight` with the proposal's own `quorum_weight` instead of the live `getThreshold()`. Codemod: `weighted-quorum`.

```ts
// v1
const ready = proposal.approvals >= (await client.getThreshold());
// v2
const ready = proposal.approval_weight >= proposal.quorum_weight;
```

### Create, approve and execute require roles

After `migrate_to_rbac`, callers need the Proposer, Approver or Executor role. Missing roles fail with `MissingRole` (52), not `Unauthorized` (3); check `hasRole` up front. Codemod: `flag-unauthorized-only`.

```ts
// v1
if (err.errorCode === ContractError.Unauthorized) showNotOwner();
// v2
if (err.errorCode === ContractError.Unauthorized || err.errorCode === ContractError.MissingRole) showNoPermission();
```

### Recurring schedules are governed proposals

`create_recurring_schedule`, `cancel_recurring_schedule` and `disburse_recurring_schedule` are superseded; `cancel_recurring_schedule` now always fails with `DeprecatedEntrypoint` (56). Use `createRecurringProposal`, `createCancelRecurringProposal` and `disburseRecurring`. Codemod: `flag-legacy-recurring`.

```ts
// v1
await client.executeTransaction("cancel_recurring_schedule", args, owner);
// v2
await client.createCancelRecurringProposal(owner, scheduleId, "Stop payroll", deadline);
```

### Compare against `ContractError` names, not numbers

Weighted governance, RBAC and recovery added many codes (for example `MissingRole`, `DeprecatedEntrypoint`, `RecoveryActive`). Numeric literals hide which error is meant and are easy to get wrong; the codemod rewrites them to `ContractError` members. Codemod: `named-error-codes`.

```ts
// v1
if (err.errorCode === 56) retryViaProposal();
// v2
if (err.errorCode === ContractError.DeprecatedEntrypoint) retryViaProposal();
```
